request.description:
**Block User API**

## 1\. API Overview

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| API Name | Block User |
| Purpose | Blocks mobile numbers from receiving WhatsApp messages through the specified WhatsApp Business Account (WABA). |
| HTTP Method | `POST` |
| Endpoint | `/api/whatsapp/blocked-members` |
| Full URL | `{{baseurl}}/api/whatsapp/blocked-members` |
| Authentication | Bearer Token |
| Content-Type | `application/json` |
| Accept | `application/json` |

## 2\. Request Headers

| Key | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | `Bearer {{Bearer Token}}` | Authenticates the API request. |
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` | Specifies that the request body is JSON. |
| `Accept` | `application/json` | Specifies that the client accepts a JSON response. |

## 3\. Request Body Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sender_id` | String | Yes | WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) number. | `{{WABA Number}}` |
| `phone_numbers` | Array | Yes | Mobile number or numbers to block. | `["{{Mobile Number}}"]` |

## 4\. Success Response

| Field | Example Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `success` | Indicates that the request succeeded. |
| `message` | `User blocked successfully.` | Confirmation message. |
| `data.phone` | `91XXXXXXXX` | Mobile number shown in the response. |
| `data.blocked_at` | `2026-03-26 10:15:32` | Date and time shown for the block action. |

### Sample Success Response

``` json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "User blocked successfully.",
  "data": {
    "phone": "91XXXXXXXX",
    "blocked_at": "2026-03-26 10:15:32"
  }
}

 ```

## 5\. Error Handling

| Error Condition | Error Message in Guide | Recommended Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Missing `sender_id` | `The sender_id field is required.` | Provide the WABA number in the request body. |
| Missing `phone` | `The phone field is required.` | Provide the mobile number in the request body. |
| Re-engagement check failure | `Re-engagement check failed: Failed to block due to re-engagement check failed` | Check that the user has interacted with the system within the previous 24 hours, for example through a Campaign, API, or Chatbot. |

## 6\. Troubleshooting

| Issue | What to Check |
| --- | --- |
| Authentication failure | Verify that the Bearer Token is present and valid. |
| Required field error | Check that the required request fields are provided. |
| Re-engagement check failure | Verify the user's interaction with the system within the previous 24 hours. |

# Unblock User API

## 1\. API Overview

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| API Name | Unblock User |
| Purpose | Removes the block on a mobile number so that it is no longer blocked through the specified WhatsApp Business Account (WABA). |
| HTTP Method | `DELETE` |
| Endpoint | `/api/whatsapp/blocked-members` |
| Full URL | `{{baseurl}}/api/whatsapp/blocked-members` |
| Authentication | Bearer Token |
| Content-Type | `application/json` |
| Accept | `application/json` |

## 2\. Request Headers

| Key | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | `Bearer {{Bearer Token}}` | Authenticates the API request. |
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` | Specifies that the request body is JSON. |
| `Accept` | `application/json` | Specifies that the client accepts a JSON response. |

## 3\. Request Body Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sender_id` | String | Yes | WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) number. | `{{WABA Number}}` |
| `phone` | String | Yes | Mobile number to unblock. | `{{Mobile Number}}` |

## 4\. Sample Request Body

| Example | JSON |
| --- | --- |
| Request | See the JSON request body configured below in the Postman Body tab. |

## 5\. Success Response

| Field | Example Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `success` | Indicates that the request succeeded. |
| `message` | `User unblocked successfully.` | Confirmation that the user was unblocked. |

### Sample Success Response

```
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "User unblocked successfully."
}

 ```

## 6\. Troubleshooting

| Issue | What to Check |
| --- | --- |
| Authentication failure | Verify the Bearer Token and confirm that it is valid. |
| Required field error | Check that both `sender_id` and `phone` are included in the request body. |
| User remains blocked | Verify the WABA number and mobile number, then check the API response. |

# File Upload User Block (Bulk via CSV)

## 1\. API Overview

| Parameter | Details |
| --- | --- |
| API Name | File Upload User Block |
| Method | POST |
| Endpoint | `/api/whatsapp/blocked-members/import-csv` |
| Full URL | `{{baseurl}}/api/whatsapp/blocked-members/import-csv` |
| Description | Block multiple users at once by uploading a CSV file containing their mobile numbers. |

## 2\. Headers

| Key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Accept | `application/json` |
| Authorization | `Bearer {{Bearer Token}}` |

## 3\. Request Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sender_id` | Text | Yes | Your WABA number. |
| `file` | File | Yes | CSV file containing mobile numbers to block. One number per row. |

## 4\. Success Response

``` json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "CSV imported successfully.",
  "data": {
    "total": 250,
    "blocked": 248,
    "failed": 2
  }
}

 ```

## 5\. Response Parameters

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | Indicates success. |
| `message` | CSV imported successfully. |
| `data.total` | Number of records found in the uploaded CSV. |
| `data.blocked` | Number of users successfully blocked. |
| `data.failed` | Number of entries that failed, such as invalid formats or duplicates. |

| Field | Details |
| --- | --- |
| API Name | Request Blocked Users |
| Method | `GET` |
| Endpoint | `{{Base URL}}/api/whatsapp/blocked-members?sender_id={{WABA Number}}&per_page={{Max 100}}&page={{Page number}}` |
| Description | Retrieve the paginated list of all users blocked for a specific WABA number. |
| `sender_id` | Required: Yes |
| `sender_id` Description | Your WABA number passed as a query parameter |
| `per_page` | Required: Optional |
| `per_page` Description | Number of records to return per page. Default: 10 |
| `page` | Required: Optional |
| `page` Description | Page number for pagination. Default: 1 |
| `Accept` | `application/json` |
| `Authorization` | `Bearer {{Bearer Token}}` |

### **Request**

``` bash
curl --location --request GET \
'https://api.yourcpaas.com/api/whatsapp/blocked-members?sender_id=WABANumber&per_page=10&page=1' \
--header 'Accept: application/json' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer {{Bearer Token}}'

 ```

### Success Response

``` json
{
  "status": "success",
  "data": {
    "total": 250,
    "per_page": 10,
    "current_page": 1,
    "blocked_members": [
      {
        "phone": "91XXXXXXXX",
        "blocked_at": "2026-03-26 10:15:32"
      },
      {
        "phone": "919123456789",
        "blocked_at": "2026-03-25 08:30:00"
      }
    ]
  }
}

 ```

| Field | Details |
| --- | --- |
| API Name | Sync Blocked Users |
| Method | `POST` |
| Endpoint | `{{Base URL}}/api/whatsapp/blocked-members/sync` |
| Description | Synchronise the blocked users list stored in CPaaS+ with the WhatsApp Business Platform. Use this after bulk imports or manual changes to ensure the block list is consistent across systems. |
| `sender_id` | Required: Yes |
| `sender_id` Description | Your official WhatsApp Business Account number |
| `Accept` | `application/json` |
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` |
| `Authorization` | `Bearer {{Bearer Token}}` |

### Request

Bash

``` bash
curl --location 'https://api.yourcpaas.com/api/whatsapp/blocked-members/sync' \
--header 'Accept: application/json' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer {{Bearer Token}}' \
--data '{
  "sender_id": "Your WhatsApp Business Account Number"
}'

 ```

### Success Response

JSON

``` json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Blocked users synced successfully.",
  "data": {
    "synced": 250,
    "synced_at": "2026-03-26 10:15:32"
  }
}

 ```

item.description:
| Field | Content |
| --- | --- |
| Folder Name | User Management |
| Description | The CPaaS+ WhatsApp User Management APIs manage blocked users associated with a WhatsApp Business Account (WABA). They support blocking an individual user, unblocking a user, bulk-blocking users through CSV upload, retrieving the blocked-user list, and synchronising the blocked-user list with the WhatsApp Business Platform. |
| Base URL | `https://api.yourcpaas.com` |
| Authentication | Bearer Token authentication. |
| Authorization Header | `Authorization: Bearer {{Bearer Token}}` |
| Common Request Headers | `Accept: application/json`. Use `Content-Type: application/json` for requests with JSON bodies. The CSV upload API uses `multipart/form-data`. |
| WABA Identifier | `sender_id` — the WhatsApp Business Account number used by these APIs. |
| Request Format | Block User, Unblock User, and Sync Blocked Users use JSON request bodies. File Upload Block uses form-data. Request Blocked Users uses query parameters. |
| API 1 — Block User | Method: `POST` \\n Endpoint: `/api/whatsapp/blocked-members` \\n Purpose: Block an individual phone number. |
| API 2 — Unblock User | Method: `DELETE` \\n Endpoint: `/api/whatsapp/blocked-members` \\n Purpose: Remove a block on an individual phone number. |
| API 3 — File Upload Block | Method: `POST` \\n Endpoint: `/api/whatsapp/blocked-members/import-csv` \\n Purpose: Bulk-block phone numbers from a CSV file. |
| API 4 — Request Blocked Users | Method: `GET` \\n Endpoint: `/api/whatsapp/blocked-members` \\n Purpose: Retrieve the blocked-user list using pagination parameters. |
| API 5 — Sync Blocked Users | Method: `POST` \\n Endpoint: `/api/whatsapp/blocked-members/sync` \\n Purpose: Synchronise the blocked-user list with the WhatsApp Business Platform. |
| Documentation Reference | Refer to each individual API request for its required fields, request examples, success responses, and any documented error conditions. |

### B. Request body parameters

| Parameter | Required / Optional | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Required | Name assigned to the template. |
| `agent_id` | Required | RCS Agent ID associated with the template. |
| `type` | Required | Template type. Use `text_message` for this request. |
| `textMessageContent` | Required | Text content of the message. Can contain variables such as `{{name}}` and `{{order_id}}`. |
| `suggestions` | Optional | Array of interactive buttons. Maximum 11 buttons. |
| `suggestions[].suggestionType` | As applicable | Button type, such as `reply`, `url_action`, or `dialer_action`. |
| `suggestions[].displayText` | As applicable | Text displayed on the button. Maximum 25 characters. |
| `suggestions[].postback` | Optional | Callback value associated with the button. |
| `suggestions[].url` | Conditional | Target URL for a `url_action` button. |
| `suggestions[].phoneNumber` | Conditional | Phone number for a `dialer_action` button. |

### C. Sample success response

``` json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Template created successfully.",
  "data": {
    "template_id": "rcs-tpl-20260326-001",

    "approval_status": "pending"
  }
}
 ```

| --- | --- |
| `status` | Overall request result, such as `success` or `error`. |
| `message` | Message describing the result. |
| `data.template_id` | Unique template ID. |
| `data.name` | Name of the created template. |
| `data.approval_status` | Template review status: `pending`, `approved`, or `rejected`. |

### D. Error response

| Error documentation | What to record |
| --- | --- |
| Sample error JSON | Not provided in the guide for this request. |
| Error details | The guide does not list request-specific errors in this section. |
| Recommended action | Ensure all required fields are supplied and conditional fields are included for the selected button type. Treat this as a validation recommendation, not a documented API error response. |

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Request Name | Media + Button |
| HTTP Method | POST |
| Endpoint | `/api/rcs/template/create` |

| Authentication | Bearer Token |

### B. Request body parameters

| Parameter | Required / Optional | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Required | Unique template name. |

| `orientation` | Required | Card layout: `HORIZONTAL` or `VERTICAL`. |
| `height` | Conditional | Height for vertical layout: `SHORT_HEIGHT`, `MEDIUM_HEIGHT` or `TALL_HEIGHT`. |
| `standAlone` | Required | Object containing the rich card's content and buttons. |
| `standAlone.cardTitle` | Required | Card title; maximum 200 characters. |
| `standAlone.cardDescription` | Optional | Card description; maximum 2,000 characters. |
| `standAlone.mediaUrl` | Optional | Publicly accessible HTTPS URL for an image or video. |
| `standAlone.suggestions` | Optional | Array of interactive buttons; maximum 4 buttons per rich card. |
| `standAlone.suggestions[].suggestionType` | Required for each button | Button type: `reply`, `url_action` or `dialer_action`. |
| `standAlone.suggestions[].displayText` | Required for each button | Button label; maximum 25 characters. |
| `standAlone.suggestions[].postback` | Optional | Callback value sent to the webhook when the button is tapped. |
| `standAlone.suggestions[].url` | Conditional | Target URL required for `url_action`. |

### C. Sample success response

``` json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Template created successfully.",
  "data": {
    "template_id": "rcs-tpl-20260326-002",

    "approval_status": "pending"
  }
}

 ```

| Response field | Description |
| --- | --- |

| `message` | Message describing the result. |
| `data.template_id` | Unique ID assigned to the template. |
| `data.name` | Template name. |
| `data.approval_status` | Template review status, such as `pending`, `approved` or `rejected`. |

### D. Error response

| Field | Error described in guide | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | The orientation field is required. | Use `HORIZONTAL` or `VERTICAL`. |
| `cardTitle` | The cardTitle field is required. | Add a title of up to 200 characters. |
| `mediaUrl` | Media URL is not publicly accessible. | Ensure the URL is a direct HTTPS link without authentication. |
| `suggestions` | Exceeds maximum of 4 buttons. | Reduce buttons to 4 or fewer per Rich Card. |

## A. Request details

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Request name | `POST Carousel` |
| Method | `POST` |
| Endpoint | `/api/rcs/template/create` |
| Base URL | `https://api.yourcpaas.com` |
| Full URL | `{{Base URL}}/api/rcs/template/create` |
| Authorization | Bearer Token |
| Header — `Content-Type` | `application/json` |
| Header — `Accept` | `application/json` |
| Body type | raw → JSON |
| Purpose | Creates an RCS carousel template containing multiple cards. Each card can include a title, description, media URL and interactive buttons. |

## B. Request parameters

| Parameter | Required? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Yes | Unique template name, e.g. `product_carousel_v1`. |
| `agent_id` | Yes | RCS Agent ID from CPaaS+ Portal → RCS → Agents. |
| `type` | Yes | Must be `carousel`. |
| `width` | Optional | Card width: `SMALL_WIDTH` or `MEDIUM_WIDTH`. |
| `height` | Optional | Card height: `SHORT_HEIGHT` or `MEDIUM_HEIGHT`. |
| `carouselList` | Yes | Array containing 2–10 card objects. |
| `carouselList[].cardTitle` | Yes | Title of each card. Maximum 200 characters. |
| `carouselList[].cardDescription` | Optional | Description of each card. Maximum 2,000 characters. |
| `carouselList[].mediaUrl` | Optional | Publicly accessible HTTPS URL for the card's image or video. |
| `carouselList[].suggestions` | Optional | Array of interactive buttons for each card. Maximum 4 buttons per card. |
| `carouselList[].suggestions[].suggestionType` | Yes, per button | Button type: `reply`, `url_action` or `dialer_action`. |
| `carouselList[].suggestions[].displayText` | Yes, per button | Button label. Maximum 25 characters. |
| `carouselList[].suggestions[].postback` | Optional | Callback value sent to the webhook when the user taps the button. |
| `carouselList[].suggestions[].url` | Conditional | Required when `suggestionType` is `url_action`. Target URL opened when the button is tapped. |

## C. Sample success response

``` json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Template created successfully.",
  "data": {
    "template_id": "rcs-tpl-20260326-003",
    "name": "product_carousel_v1",
    "approval_status": "pending"
  }
}

 ```

| Response field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | Indicates the request submission status. |
| `message` | Confirms that the template was created. |
| `data.template_id` | Unique ID assigned to the template. |
| `data.name` | Name of the created template. |
| `data.approval_status` | Template approval status. The sample shows `pending`. |

## D. Error responses

| Field | Error described in the guide | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `carouselList` | Minimum 2 cards required | Add at least 2 card objects to the array. |
| `carouselList` | Exceeds maximum of 10 cards | Reduce the carousel to 10 cards or fewer. |
| `suggestions` | Exceeds maximum of 4 buttons | Reduce buttons per card to 4 or fewer. |

``` json
  "data": {
 ```
``` json
    "message_id": "rcs-jio-msg-xyz789abc",
    "to": "91XXXXXXXX",
    "status": "submitted",
    "received_at": "2026-03-26 10:15:32"
  }
}

 ```

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | Indicates whether the request was successful. |
| `message_id` | Unique message ID used for the Status Check API. |
| `to` | Recipient mobile number. |
| `status` inside `data` | Message submission status, such as `submitted` or `failed`. |
| `received_at` | Timestamp when the platform received the request. |

### D. Error Responses

| Error | Resolution |
| --- | --- |
| `botId` field is required | Add the Jio Agent ID from CPaaS+ Portal → RCS → Agents. |
| Recipient is not RCS-enabled on Jio | Verify that the recipient's device or number supports RCS on Jio. |
| Unsupported button type for this operator | Verify that the suggestion type is supported by Jio. |

| Method | `GET` |

| Purpose | Check the delivery status of an RCS message sent through the JIO flow. |

### B. Request Parameters

| Parameter | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | Query parameter | Yes | The message ID returned by the RCS Send API. |

### C. Sample Success Response

The API guide provides the following sample response for Status Check:

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "message_id": "7870e824-693d-4e25-b424-099f273c89a8",
    "status": "read",
    "status_description": "Unknown status",
    "message_type": "text",
    "priority": null,
    "direction": "outbound",
    "number": "919202511257",
    "created_at": "2026-03-13 15:44:31",
    "scheduled_at": "2026-03-13 15:44:31",
    "sent_at": "2026-03-13 15:44:32",
    "delivered_at": "2026-03-13 15:44:41",
    "failed_at": null,
    "cancelled_at": null,
    "updated_at": "2026-03-13 15:44:53"
  }
}

 ```

| --- | --- |

| `message_id` | Unique identifier of the message. |
| `status` | Current message status; the sample shows `read`. |

| `message_type` | Type of message sent. |
| `priority` | Message priority; `null` in the sample. |
| `direction` | Message direction; `outbound` in the sample. |

| `cancelled_at` | Cancellation timestamp, if applicable. |

item.name: Flow Builder API

request.description:
## A. Request Details

| Field | Details |
| --- | --- |
| API Name | Message Send API |
| HTTP Method | POST |
| Endpoint | `{{Flow Webhook URL}}` |
| Example Endpoint | `https://api.yourcpaas.com/flow-api/webhook/trigger/{{flow_id}}` |
| Base URL | `https://api.yourcpaas.com` |
| Purpose | Trigger a published CPaaS+ flow for a specific recipient. |
| Precondition | The flow must be Published and Active in the CPaaS+ Portal before calling the API. |

## B. Request Headers

| Key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` |
| `Accept` | `application/json` |
| `Authorization` | `Bearer {{Bearer Token}}` |

## C. Request Parameters

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `phone` | Conditional | Recipient mobile number. Required if the flow uses SMS or WhatsApp. |
| `email` | Conditional | Recipient email address. Required if the flow uses Email. |
| `var1` | Optional | Dynamic variable injected into the flow at runtime, e.g. customer name or order ID. |
| `var2` | Optional | Pass the required number of dynamic values in template variables for respective channels. |

## D. Sample Success Response

| Field | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `success/error` | Overall request submission status |
| `message` | `Flow jobs dispatched successfully` | Confirmation message from platform |

### E.Success response sample

``` json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Flow jobs dispatched successfully"
}

 ```

## F. Error Responses

| Field | Error | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `phone/email` | Invalid JSON format. Please check your request body. | Ensure you are passing email or phone or params correctly. |
| `flow_id` | Flow not found | Configure the flow in your CPaaS+ Portal → Flow Builder. |
| `flow_id` | Flow is not published or inactive | Publish and activate the flow in the CPaaS+ Portal before calling the API. |

### Sample Error Responses

Flow Not Found

``` json
{
  "status": "error",
  "message": "Flow not found."
}

 ```

Missing Field

``` json
{
  "status": "error",
  "message": "Invalid JSON format. Please check your request body."
}

 ```
